band_note: 80% empirical absolute-residual band calibrated on a 28-day validation window. Coverage is reported on the 28-day holdout; 180-day extrapolation is not calibrated. Aggregated bounds sum route-level bounds and are not a joint confidence interval.
selection: Calendar Ridge vs weekday trailing-8 mean, selected by validation MAE, then evaluated on a separate last-28-day holdout.
